response.justification: Bogdan is a talented, versatile full-stack and systems engineer with strong open-source, DevOps, and mentoring credentials, but his career is centered on web/mobile platforms in TypeScript, Node.js, DLang, and similar languages rather than C++ and large-scale cloud compute infrastructure. He does not meet the core minimum qualifications of 8 years of C++ programming or 5 years building large-scale distributed/compute infrastructure, making him a poor fit for this specific C++-heavy cloud compute platform leadership role.
strengths: Extensive senior/staff-level experience (15+ years) across web, mobile, and embedded systems
Demonstrated technical leadership: workshops, talks, mentoring, and founding an open-source platform
Experience with distributed/micro-services infrastructure handling high request volumes (Dunnhumby/Sociomantic)
concerns: C++ experience is limited to a single ~6-month role (National Instruments) plus a student project, far short of the 8-year requirement
No evident production cloud compute platform experience (AWS/GCP/Azure infra architecture) at the scale implied by the role
Career trajectory is broad generalist/full-stack rather than deep infrastructure/compute specialist, misaligned with the role's core focus

key_factors.factor: Lack of large-scale cloud compute infrastructure focus
Strong leadership, mentoring, and open-source track record
